motivation: Outcome-blind clarification of first source selection and predeclared calibration/coverage safety thresholds, before any eligible November 15 target

source_policy.first_completed_definition: First terminal, fully written C03 daily_research_generation_manifest.json by UTC timestamp encoded in its immutable folder name, regardless of SUCCESS/BLOCKED status. Do not skip failed batches to choose later easier candidates.
source_policy.primary_universe_limit: Only source-native original C03 successfully frozen Gamma research player-games that can be independently reverified before target start, max 4 C03 forecasts/day; model outcomes and original trial settlements are not used for candidate selection.
source_policy.coverage_caveat: M2 source gating inherited. No claim of standalone S1 coverage advantage on Gamma-abstained cases; those remain separate research-source failures until independently preregistered prospective S1-only source pipeline exists.

guardrails.point_estimate_calibration_residual: Abs(mean predicted P(SOG=0) minus observed zero incidence) <= 0.06 in matched played cohort; report date-cluster uncertainty and position slices.
guardrails.tail6_residual: Abs(mean predicted P(SOG>=6) minus observed tail6 incidence) <= 0.035 in matched played cohort; report exact event count, date-cluster uncertainty.
guardrails.central_90pct_interval_coverage: Empirical matched played-game coverage between 0.80 and 0.98 under prespecified shortest central 90% interval algorithm; disclose discreteness and nominal exceedance.
guardrails.matched_forecast_population: No model-specific missing scores; all M0/S1/M2 comparisons on exactly same played player-games, with all abstains and no-played recorded outside scored denominator.
guardrails.decision: Any required primary or safety check that cannot be evaluated with adequate data => INCONCLUSIVE, not NONINFERIOR. Scientific and release gates separate.

power_note: 60 slate dates and 16 weeks are an enrollment floor, NOT 80% power. Under independent-date Normal approximation and effect delta=0, SD=0.003 needs ~71 dates; SD=0.005 needs ~197; 7-day block dependence generally increases uncertainty. Fixed horizon and no early stopping unchanged.
change_control: Clarification binding is append-only and source-hash locked; any further substantive change requires a new experiment ID and future cohort, no silent replace.
